title: 4 BHK Builder Floor for Rent
description:
Experience modern luxury and comfortable living with this brand-new 4 BHK builder floor available for rent in Palam Vihar, Gurugram. Designed with contemporary interiors, spacious rooms, quality fittings and excellent natural light, this premium floor is ideal for families and corporate tenants looking for a peaceful and well-connected residential location.

Property Highlights:

Spacious 4 BHK layout
Brand-new builder floor
Modern interiors and premium fittings
Spacious bedrooms and living area
Excellent natural light and ventilation
Dedicated parking
Peaceful residential surroundings
Suitable for families and corporate tenants
Convenient access to markets, schools, hospitals and daily conveniences

Location Advantage:
Located in Palam Vihar, the property offers excellent connectivity to Dwarka Expressway, Delhi, IGI Airport, Sector 21, Sector 22, Sector 23, Udyog Vihar and major commercial hubs of Gurugram.
